schema_note: Record shape mirrors engine/carriers/MANIFEST.json (carrier_id, title, drive_id, drive_path, bytes, sha256, blob_stored, blob_path, lane, computes, arithmetic, certifying, certifying_note, authority_tier, source_status) with two extra keys, 'recovery' and 'scope_holds'. Written here and NOT into engine/carriers/MANIFEST.json because another workflow owns that file; merging these records into it is a follow-up step for whoever owns it.
promotes_nothing: OBL-H5-JETMOD, OBL-H5-ZBAND, OBL-H5-REMOTE-THRESHOLD, OBL-D1-PROMOTE and BOTH pieces of D3-LEMMA-RN-UNIF remain OPEN. Original prize problems solved: 0. A byte-exact recovery is provenance, not a bound.
drive_id_note: The seven zip-member payloads have no standalone Drive file id; drive_id is null for them and the Drive objects actually used are listed under recovery.reading_copy_doc_id and recovery.archive_carrier_drive_ids. rnu_ds3.py is a native Drive file and carries its own drive_id.

carriers.title: d3_rn_unif.py (frozen RN uniform rung-closure engine)
carriers.lane: A5 / D3-LEMMA-RN-UNIF (rung r = 1/20, fixed axis, side-24)
carriers.computes: periodized side-24 plane kernel kplane/kdcov/kdcov_d over the first image shell; the 6-pin Schur station (station_fast, station_fast_full); the DS/DM value-gradient-Hessian arithmetic and the assembled kap_far (kappa_far_ds); the moment-series envelopes env_form/env_tau; the per-point bound kp1_point with tau_bounds_full, chi2_grad_bound, mean_grad_exact, cov9_grad_exact, ratio_bounds; and the adaptive polar certifier certify_cell/run_certification over {|y| in [5,17]} against KAP_BUDGET = 0.68. run_certification is DEFINED BUT NEVER CALLED in the frozen body (last statement is the probe loop, line 2241).
carriers.arithmetic: mpmath binary floating point at mp.dps = 100, set once at d3_rn_unif.py line 41 and never changed; no fractions.Fraction, no decimal.Decimal and no interval arithmetic occurs anywhere in the recovered bodies
carriers.certifying_note: NON-CERTIFYING. Recovery of a byte-exact carrier is provenance, not proof. Nothing in this record promotes, closes, discharges or reclassifies any claim. D3-LEMMA-RN-UNIF Piece 1 and Piece 2 both remain OPEN; OBL-H5-JETMOD, OBL-H5-ZBAND, OBL-H5-REMOTE-THRESHOLD and OBL-D1-PROMOTE all remain OPEN.
